evidence_type: direct assay (in vitro deamination, ssDNA binding)
claim: APOBEC4 is a catalytically active cytidine deaminase
key_finding: No detectable cytidine deamination activity in vitro; weak ssDNA interaction; APOBEC4 instead enhanced HIV-1 LTR and general promoter transcription
context: Human APOBEC4 ectopically expressed in 293T/HeLa; in vitro deamination assay
confidence_limitations: Moderate-high. Negative assay; substrate, cofactor and post-translational requirements unknown; no catalytic-site mutant control

claim: APOBEC4 deaminates DNA cytosines in vivo
key_finding: Human APOBEC4 expression was non-mutagenic in E. coli and yeast, while AID, APOBEC1, APOBEC3G and lamprey CDA1 were strongly mutagenic in the same system
context: E. coli and S. cerevisiae reporter mutagenesis
confidence_limitations: Moderate. Heterologous system; folding, localisation and expression level of APOBEC4 not independently verified

claim: APOBEC4 proteins are active polynucleotide (deoxy)cytidine deaminases
key_finding: Zinc-coordinating motifs and deaminase-domain secondary structure are conserved, from which activity was inferred
context: Iterative database searches across mammals, chicken, frog
confidence_limitations: Low for activity. Explicitly a prediction; this is the source of the ISS-style annotation that still propagates

claim: APOBEC4 zinc motif is conserved and functional
key_finding: Chicken APOBEC4 HXE...PC(X)2-6C motif with His97, Glu99, Pro130, Cys131, Cys138; overexpression inhibited Newcastle disease virus
context: Chicken DT40, HD11, MSB-1 cells; in vivo NDV infection
confidence_limitations: Low-moderate for catalysis. No deamination assay and no catalytic-dead mutant; antiviral effect may be deaminase-independent

claim: APOBEC4 acts as a C-to-U editing enzyme
key_finding: APOBEC4 identified and validated as a ribosome biogenesis factor; for the paralog APOBEC3A, a catalytically dead mutant retained the growth and protein-synthesis effect
confidence_limitations: Moderate. Mechanism demonstrated mainly for APOBEC3A; suggests APOBEC4 function may be deaminase-independent

claim: Testis-enriched APOBEC4 is required for male fertility / spermatogenesis mRNA editing
key_finding: Apobec4 knockout mice are viable and were among the lines dispensable for male fertility under the conditions tested
confidence_limitations: Moderate. Argues against the spermatogenesis mRNA-editing hypothesis of Rogozin 2005; mouse-specific, redundancy not excluded

stance: refutes (the mechanism proposed in the seed hypothesis)
claim: The APOBEC4 zinc pocket is not geometrically assembled
key_finding: Zinc-anchor superposition onto APOBEC3A RMSD 0.40 A; core 128 CA at 1.36 A; transplanted Zn sits 2.24 A from His93 ND1, 2.50/1.98 A from Cys127/Cys134 SG, 4.04 A from Glu95 OE2, all inside the experimental range of active enzymes
confidence_limitations: High for geometry, low for turnover. Apo model with no zinc modelled; side-chain rotamers predicted, not observed

claim: Catalytic positions are degenerating in APOBEC4
key_finding: His93 99.1%, Glu95 98.2%, Pro126 99.1%, Cys127 98.7%, Cys134 98.7% identity against 45% median whole-protein identity and 4-5% at unconstrained positions
context: 87 mammals, 118 birds, 11 squamates, 3 turtles, 1 crocodilian, 5 amphibians
confidence_limitations: High for the conservation measurement. Conservation implies constraint on the metal site, not necessarily deaminase turnover

citation: This analysis (5SWW ssDNA transplanted onto AF-Q8WW27)
claim: APOBEC4 substrate-recognition surface diverges from active APOBECs
key_finding: 35/108 ssDNA atoms clash (<2.8 A) versus 3/108 natively; target cytosine superimposes on His65 (0.73 A); A3A W98 to Asn124, D131 to Thr160, Y132 to His159; cleft net charge -1 versus +3 in APOBEC3A
context: AlphaFold apo model; APOBEC3A-ssDNA NMR complex as donor
confidence_limitations: Moderate. Loop1 and loop7 reorganise on DNA binding, so an apo model overstates occlusion

claim: A buried zinc indicates catalytic incompetence
key_finding: Probe-accessible fraction at the zinc: APOBEC3A 4XXO 0.092, 5SWW 0.042, APOBEC3G 3IR2 0.015, APOBEC4 0.005, and 0.000 for active AID (5W0R), APOBEC1 (6X91) and APOBEC3A 5KEG
confidence_limitations: Metric rejected. Active enzymes span the full range, so burial cannot be used as an activity argument
